_: THE PLACES A SENTENCE SENDS THE OWNER, AND THE WORDS THEY NEVER SEE. A sentence that names a place asks words.place(id) (taskuary/words.py, website/src/words.js) for its name and its link - never a path typed into the sentence, so a page that moves or is renamed is fixed here once. `href` is the link the canvas already opens (website/src/canvasLinks.js, appLinks.js); '' for a place that is on the screen and has no link of its own. `does`, on a page the Assistant brings up, is what that page holds - the words the Assistant reads to pick it (concierge.pages_block, search.places). `jargon` is every word a non-coder must never read in a line the app writes for them.

settings.name: Settings
settings.does: every switch of the app, group by group - how mail is sorted, replies, notifications, sync, the agents

rules.name: Settings → Routing policies
rules.does: the routing rules that decide where mail goes before anything reads it

docs.name: Settings → Docs
docs.does: the operator documents the app reads - SOUL, JOB, TRIAGE, COUNSEL and the rest

memory.name: Settings → Docs → LEARNED.md
memory.does: the app's memory of the owner - what they said, their verdicts, what it learned; edit a line, or Keep, Wrong, Forget

audit.name: Settings → Audit integrity
audit.does: the tamper-evident record of everything the app did, and the check of it

updates.name: Settings → Updates
updates.does: Taskuary's own version - which build runs, whether a new version (the latest release) is out, and the one button that installs it and reopens the app. Updating, upgrading or reinstalling Taskuary itself is that button

profiles.name: Settings → Profiles
profiles.does: the agent profiles - each worker's standing instructions

advice_none._: WHEN THE ADVISOR LIGHTS NOTHING (advisor.status {none: why}). The owner, 2026-10-23: an obvious move is an EMPTY strip and one lit button - "No suggestion...", "Nothing to decide...", "Thinking..." and every other sentence explaining a silence went, so only the one reason that has a way out is said: no AI connected, where the move needs one. `move` is what the row lights for it (`ai`: the row's own Connect an AI, else the strip's). Any other reason is silent, and Next is lit.

advice_rule._: THE ONE RULEBOOK (the owner's rulings, 2026-10-23; design phase A): every state the Advisor decides from facts the app keeps - never the words of a mail - with the line the strip says and the button it lights, the same on the desk canvas, the Tasks tab, a phone chat and the desk at phone width. `line` '' is silent: the lit button does the talking, and a line is only ever a fact the card does not show (an age, a clash, a failure, a promise nothing backs), never an explanation. `lit` is the verbs in order of preference - the first the row draws is lit, `next` when none is, and [] lights nothing (an agent asking is answered in its pane; a closed task's Reopen stays outlined). `ask`: the model reads intent there (an ask that is work or someone else's, a draft promising what nothing shows, a duplicate by subject, a buried ask, an idea) - the rule's button stands, lit at once, until it answers. {who} a person, {ago} how long, {why} a failure's plain reason, {ref} a task, {clash} the meeting it clashes with, {days} working days (days past the due day on a wait that has one - the header's own count), {step} a goal's step, {domain} a sender's domain. A duplicate pair is decided once (rulebook.survivor): only the newer one is the duplicate, folded into the one that stays.

waiting_late_usual.line: {who} usually answers in {usual}; this is {days} days.

duplicate.line: Same ask as {ref} - fold it into that one.

loose_ends._: WHAT FELL THROUGH, SAID ON ITS ROW (sweep.py, 2026-10-20): the daily check's one sentence for each way an item can sit where nothing will move it, and the reason under it (`_why`). {ref} is the task's TQ number, {who} the person, {gist} their words, {ago} how long ago.
loose_ends.unanswered: {who} asked "{gist}" {ago} - no answer, no task, nothing decided
loose_ends.unanswered_why: a person asked you this over {days} days ago and nothing has happened to it since
loose_ends.no_step_why: it is open, and nothing on your list or anyone else's moves it
loose_ends.waiting_nobody_why: it says waiting, but not on whom - nothing will bring it back
loose_ends.waiting_no_date: {ref} is waiting on {who} with no date
loose_ends.waiting_no_date_why: they have been quiet longer than they usually take to answer, and nothing brings it back - give it a date, or chase them

nouns._: ONE NAME FOR EACH THING THE OWNER IS SHOWN (2026-10-19 UI walk: the coding tools on this computer were 'AI CLI agents' on their card, 'Connections > AI CLI agents' in a hint and their own crumb, each typed apart). A surface that names one asks words.noun(id).

gone._: SURFACES THAT NO LONGER EXIST, named in no line the owner reads: the Timeline (removed 2026-10-15), the Reports tab and the Assistant tab (Reports is a page of the canvas, the chat is the app). Matched as written - 'timeline' in a sentence is a word. The page's walk (deadend_check.mjs WORDS) and words.jargon_in flag them with the jargon.

dashboard._: A DASHBOARD'S OWN WORDS (dashboards.py, website/src/dashboard/): its doors, its filters and the buttons on its page. The page reads them from here, never typed in a component.
dashboard.tab_hint: your systems' numbers on one screen - charts, tiles and lists that refresh on a schedule, set up by describing it
dashboard.example: Open tasks by kind, mail in per day by channel, and who wrote most - refreshed every morning.
dashboard.never: It has not run yet - Run now fills it.
dashboard.empty: No dashboards yet - + New dashboard describes one and sets it up.
dashboard.no_change: nothing before this range to compare
dashboard.or_start: Or start from a ready one
dashboard.sources_hint: What it reads, as a report's sources are. Each one's rows feed every component bound to it; its date column is what the range cuts by.
dashboard.date: date column - the range cuts by it
dashboard.shows_hint: Each component is one preset over one source. It draws above as you change it; Save keeps it.
dashboard.orphan: it reads no source - pick one

windows.now: what is true now - no range cuts it

tasks: one row per task: its kind, status, when it arrived and closed, how long it has waited
mail: one row per message in: its day, channel and sender, and whether it became a task
flow: one row per stage a message reached: came in, triaged, on a task, its task closed
agent_runs: one row per agent session: its day, the agent, how it ended and its minutes
replies: one row per reply decided: its day, channel and the hours from the ask to the answer
